title: Snake meets billiards — Tamahebi is out now #shorts
description:
Tamahebi: Snake Billiards is out now on the App Store, free.

Pull back anywhere on the table and let go. Your trail becomes your body, and you can bounce off yourself to reach the balls. Eat two in one shot for a bonus shot, and clear stages in fewer shots for 3 stars.

- 800+ stages, every one verified solvable
- A new Daily Table every day
- Collect 20+ buddies

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830031291

This is the game from Day 1 of our series "AI ships an app a day". The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

#indiegame #puzzlegame #iphonegame #snakegame #billiards
